name: Weather markets: ensemble-forecast bucket trading and station-observation sniping
one_line: ~100 daily city-temperature ladders ($2.2-3.4M/day): price buckets from station-corrected NWP ensembles a day ahead, or buy the determined bucket at 0.80-0.98 off the resolving station's page and sell to the 0.99 bidders seconds later.
category: Information edge (public meteorological data; the sniper is file 13 at 100 markets a day)
maturity: Established, small capacity, for the same-day sniper and for day-ahead bucket taking as a trade (Poligarch $194.9k realised maker with $30.2k rebates + $10.0k rewards, HighTempTation $87.4k sniper: 482/490 resolved buckets won, $6.5k on $108k in 14 days, 6 s round trips; HondaCivic $67.5k, Bilberry $41.5k takers); the ensemble METHOD is Emerging as a documented edge (no published post-mortem beats the mid); Bloomberg-named Atte inactive since April, ColdMath out of weather since 7 Sep 2026
requires_ai: no; optional LLM to compile station / unit / hourly-toggle / fallback rules offline
edge: Ensemble vs retail bucket pricing day-ahead; first read of the station's public observation same-day; reward pools for makers
capital: $1k-$10k; sniper recycles in seconds, day-ahead depth $350-6k per city
build_time: 2-3 weeks forecast build, 1-2 weeks sniper, on an existing execution stack
opportunity_size: $65-100M/month ladder turnover, flat ~100 ladders/day; ~$1k/day gross same-day edge for all snipers; ~$7k/day reward pools on live mid buckets; top 3 earn $15-65k/month
expected_results: wallets: $6.5k/14 days sniper (6.0% of cost), $64.5k/month top maker, $48k/month top taker; newcomer guess $300-1,500/month at $10k
competition: median 6, up to 28-40 wallets per resolved bucket; a dozen $13-65k/month specialists; GFS-counting bot forks
flag: none for trading; sensor tampering prohibited and criminal (Paris CDG, file 31)
validate: 3 weeks: ensemble vs Gamma mids on 20 cities, station bias fit, Brier skill > 0 and > $10/day per $1k; 1 week of NOAA polling vs Data API first-0.90 fills
top_risk: Capacity: $156 median stale asks per bucket, 10-28 rivals, thin day-ahead books
solo_fit_reason: Free data, objective next-day resolution, ~100 independent markets a day and on-chain proof that solo wallets earn $5-15k a month; but the pool is small and shared, so it is a $1-15k side book, not a scaling business.
speed_class: latency-sensitive (sniper: first read of the :51 observation, 6 s round trips); execution-sensitive for the day-ahead build
capacity_ceiling: ~$10-15k solo: ~$1k/day of same-day edge shared by dozens; $350-6k day-ahead depth per city
services: Polymarket Data API (trades, user-stats, weather leaderboard)

open_doubts: The 'faster weather feed' explanation for HighTempTation is unproven; the tape is consistent with reading the same public page first and selling to 0.99 bids within seconds.

The Data API weather leaderboard category is the weather tag (pandemics, earthquakes, election-adjacent); only wallets whose tapes were checked are cited as weather earners, and stupid22's $92k month is only 41% temperature.
The stale-ask capacity sample is 26 buckets from two days; the $1k/day gross pool and the ~$7k/day reward figure (sum of configured daily rates, not observed payouts) are derived extrapolations.
Whether the configured reward rates are paid in full depends on competitiveness scaling; only Poligarch's and stupid22's lifetime reward income confirm the pools pay.
Open-Meteo commercial prices were not readable in the fetched HTML; the free tier's 10,000 calls/day and the Professional-plan requirement for commercial ensemble data are from the page text.

No public evidence of a bias-corrected ensemble beating the day-ahead mids on Polymarket; the honest post-mortems (linuzri, HN maker) are break-even and the profitable day-ahead wallets (HondaCivic, Bilberry, Poligarch) do not publish their method.
Kalshi bid/ask fields were empty in the unauthenticated response, so the cross-venue comparison is by series existence only.
